title: Speaking — Doing things for the first time
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on doing things for the first time.

questions: What places are within walking distance of your home?
When are the streets near your home most lively?
Which part of the area would you show to a visitor?

part1.topic: Doing things for the first time
questions: Do you like to try unfamiliar activities often?
What makes you feel ready to try something new?

part2.topic: Describe a first attempt at something which went better than expected.
points: what made you feel more comfortable
part2.closing: and explain why the early success mattered to you.

part3.topic: Doing things for the first time
questions: How can schools make beginners comfortable enough to take learning risks?
Why might people avoid new activities after a single bad experience?
How has everyday life connected with doing things for the first time changed for people of different ages?
